item_short_desc: Stay warm and protected in harsh winter conditions with Rothco’s Deluxe Camo 3-Hole Face Mask. Designed for maximum coverage, this face mask features three precision-cut holes for your eyes and mouth, allowing clear vision and easy breathing. The fitted elastic neck ensures a secure fit that stays in place, while the durable acrylic material provides excellent insulation. Perfect for outdoor activities like hunting, skiing, or hiking, this face mask offers both functionality and style with its classic camo pattern.
